llm_response.reason: The website presents itself as an e-commerce shop yet lacks a functional privacy/customer information notice (returns 404), which is legally required, especially for EU commerce. There are SSL certificate issues detected, which threaten encryption and indicate poor management. There is no visible legitimate company/contact information or evidence of real business operation. These factors match several key scam website characteristics, especially ambiguous privacy details (#7), information on non-existent companies (#4), and unsafe connection practices, all of which signal a high likelihood of the site being fraudulent.
